description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka   -   Cancellation of the Licence issued to Lankaputhra Development  Bank Ltd.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the cancellation of a banking license and the merger of financial institutions (Lankaputhra Development Bank Limited with Pradeshiya Sanwardhana Bank) under the Banking Act. It deals specifically with banking business regulations and financial institution operations, which falls under commercial matters related to banking and financial institutions.
